RDS SQL Server, Db2, Custom SQL Server, Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL and the EC2 pricing variants use live-editor-captured component payloads and costs because the native engine does not implement those column-form/pricing-strategy paths yet.
Every service component is stored in the saved estimate; the public page collapses them into five group rows.
notes: Group totals, the estimate total, and the upfront total match the live editor recomputation exactly.
EBS includes all 7 volume types: gp2, gp3, io1, io2, st1, sc1, magnetic, plus snapshots, restore, and direct APIs.
RDS includes MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, Custom Oracle, SQL Server, Db2, Custom SQL Server, Aurora MySQL, Aurora PostgreSQL.

VPC includes all 13 sub-services: VPN, Network Access Analyzer, Reachability Analyzer, Traffic Mirroring, public IPv4, IPAM, data transfer, Route Server, NAT (zonal and regional), Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Gateway Load Balancer, Cloud WAN.
EKS includes standard and extended support, Argo CD/ACK/KRO capabilities, and tiered hybrid nodes.

EC2 variants: on-demand, 1-year standard RI, 3-year convertible RI (592 upfront), Spot (70% discount), 3-year Compute Savings Plan, and 3-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan (946.08 upfront), with EBS, monitoring, data transfer and additional-cost components from the captured advance-estimate payload.
